text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and have a quick shower. After that, I eat breakfast and check my emails. I start work at nine and follow a regular schedule with short breaks. At lunchtime, I go for a walk or do some exercise, which helps me stay healthy. In the evening, I cook dinner and spend time with my family. I also read a book before bed. I try to keep the same routine every day because consistency gives me energy and helps me feel calm and organised.
